title.guidance: Max 10 words. A short, plain phrase naming what the function does.

description.guidance: Max 2 lines. One or two sentences expanding on the title.

details.guidance: Up to 4 lines. Reference relevant base/stats/tidyverse functions this builds on, where it aids understanding.

param.guidance: One line per parameter. State the expected type and purpose concisely.

return.guidance: 1-2 sentences. Describe the type and shape of the returned value, including any disclosure-control or safety behavior relevant to the caller.

examples.guidance: A runnable example. See role-specific guidance for DataSHIELD packages.

description.guidance: Max 2 lines, only if the function's purpose isn't obvious from the title.

examples.guidance: Optional — skip for straightforward internal helpers.
